dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 02, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Phillies Shut Down Orioles in Blowout Victory**

The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles 8-0 behind a team effort on the mound. Tim Mayza earned the win, while Zack Wheeler struck out three in two scoreless innings. Bryce Harper and Alec Bohm each had a hit for the Phillies. Bryan De La Cruz homered and drove in three runs to pace the offense.

**Braves Edge Nationals in Low-Scoring Affair**

The Atlanta Braves outlasted the Washington Nationals 4-2, with Dylan Dodd earning the win. Mike Yastrzemski homered and drove in two runs for the Nationals, but it wasn't enough. Didier Fuentes struck out four in two scoreless innings for the Braves.

**Cardinals Take Down Blue Jays**

The St. Louis Cardinals defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1, with Matthew Liberatore pitching six strong innings. Jordan Walker drove in two runs to lead the Cardinals' offense. Liberatore struck out seven and allowed just one hit.

**Guardians Blank Diamondbacks**

The Cleveland Guardians shut out the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0, with Gavin Williams pitching five and two-thirds scoreless innings. Williams struck out 10 and allowed just one hit. Patrick Bailey homered for the Diamondbacks.

**Reds Rout Pirates**

The Cincinnati Reds defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 10-2, with Chase Burns earning the win. Tyler Stephenson homered and drove in two runs to lead the Reds' offense. Burns struck out nine and allowed just two earned runs.

**White Sox Cruise Past Rays**

The Chicago White Sox defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 9-1, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Everson Pereira homered and drove in four runs to lead the White Sox' offense. Griffin Jax pitched five strong innings for the Rays.

**Marlins Shut Down Mets**

The Miami Marlins defeated the New York Mets 2-0, with Sandy Alcantara earning the win. Joe Mack homered for the Marlins. Alcantara pitched six scoreless innings and struck out five.

**Astros Take Down Rangers**

The Houston Astros defeated the Texas Rangers 7-3, with Bryan Abreu earning the win. Jeremy Peña homered and drove in two runs to lead the Astros' offense. Peter Lambert pitched five and two-thirds scoreless innings for the Rangers.

**Yankees Edge Cubs**

The New York Yankees defeated the Chicago Cubs 2-1, with Gerrit Cole earning the win. José Caballero homered for the Yankees. Cole pitched six scoreless innings and struck out seven.

**Rockies Rout Royals**

The Colorado Rockies defeated the Kansas City Royals 8-1, with Kyle Freeland earning the win. Jake McCarthy homered and drove in three runs to lead the Rockies' offense. Freeland pitched nine scoreless innings and struck out eight.

**Angels Shut Down Brewers**

The Los Angeles Angels defeated the Milwaukee Brewers 3-0, with Walbert Ureña earning the win. Wade Meckler homered for the Angels. Jacob Misiorowski pitched seven scoreless innings for the Brewers.

**Tigers Dominate Athletics**

The Detroit Tigers defeated the Oakland Athletics 11-0, with Keider Montero earning the win. Eduardo Valencia drove in four runs to lead the Tigers' offense. Montero pitched two scoreless innings.

**Padres Edge Giants**

The San Diego Padres defeated the San Francisco Giants 5-4, with Griffin Canning earning the win. Jackson Merrill homered and drove in two runs to lead the Padres' offense. Rafael Devers homered for the Giants.

**Mariners Outlast Twins**

The Seattle Mariners defeated the Minnesota Twins 7-6, with Andrés Muñoz earning the save. Royce Lewis homered and drove in three runs to lead the Twins' offense. George Kirby pitched seven scoreless innings for the Mariners.

**Red Sox Beat Dodgers**

The Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 8-4, with Jake Bennett earning the win. Masataka Yoshida homered and drove in two runs to lead the Red Sox' offense. Kyle Hurt pitched two scoreless innings for the Dodgers.
